title: Three views of the experimental Arup tailless monoplane (Fig. 9)
description: Composite of three photographs of the semi-circular-wing Arup tailless monoplane: a side view on the ground, an underside view showing the lettering "ARUP" and registration "12894", and a front view in flight. The partially cut caption reads "...ee views of an Experimental Arup tailless Monoplane" and it is labelled "Fig. 9". Accompanying text cites Jane's All the World's Aircraft (1935) and notes unconventional aircraft may explain some flying disk reports.
